name: Vortex Lattice
desc: A superfluid that cannot rotate the way ordinary matter does, so it punches an Abrikosov lattice of quantized vortices through itself — each a bottomless hole where the density hits exactly zero and the phase winds by exactly one turn — the whole crystal wheeling as a body and ringing with slow Tkachenko waves; as a luminous condensate pierced by black cores, a forked interference pattern, a raw phase pinwheel map, a grainy absorption shot, or spectral false-color.

energy.doc: circulation per vortex — how fast the whole lattice wheels, plus fringe count and glow (the master knob)

scale.doc: true optical zoom into the lattice — resolves individual cores and their phase winding

speed.doc: time rate — lattice motion and the chemical-potential fringe sweep

density.doc: vortex COUNT — the lattice constant: a few fat cores through to a dense crystal

heal.doc: healing length — core size, from needle-fine punctures to fat overlapping holes that eat the condensate

hue.doc: hue of the condensate (the core depths take the complement)

x.doc: pan across the lattice when magnified

y.doc: pan down the lattice when magnified

style.doc: aesthetic: luminous condensate with black cores and bright rims / forked interference fringes / raw phase as a pinwheel colormap / grainy greyscale absorption shot / spectral false-color

seed.doc: deterministic seed for the lattice's initial displacement off its ideal sites (this is what rings the Tkachenko modes)
